I took a break for a few months and came back to bowling. I found this app again and wanted to use it. When I tried to log in my games, it now told me it was a Pro feature. What???? The entire point of the app was a free way to track my games, now I have to pay for everything. I remember Pro just being for stuff like precise stats but now to even use the app you need money. This is probably the biggest falloff I’ve ever seen from an app.

reviews.title: Should be better for the price
reviews.text:
This is by far the nicest looking bowling app I’ve used. I live in a city that doesn’t have any automatic scoring centers in it so I have to keep my score manually.  This is where the fatal flaw of this app lies which I discovered while keeping my league scores tonight. I kept track of every frame in real time and when I reached the end of each game I hit Save. You’d think if you hit Save then that score would be logged and become part of your average calculation.  However, this app doesn’t add your games to your average until you’re done recording whole block.  

Somehow, after my three league games were recorded, I accidentally started a new game. When I backed out of this game (because I was done bowling) it erased all of my scores. Consequently, I lost all my data for the night. This app needs to redo the interface so that when you press save at the end of a game, it is truly saved.  It also needs a way to cancel out of a game that is started in error without affecting other scores.  Until they fix these features, I will use the other bowling app that is only a $9 one-time charge. Even thought is not as pretty, it gives you most of the same data and saves the games as you input them.

The app is useless now unless you’re willing to pay a subscription. Not worth it!!!

reviews.title: Paywall score tracking?? Bye!
reviews.text:
This app is worthless now.  When it came out, it was great.  Now, the greed of Kyle Troop and everyone involved has taken over.  They couldn’t be happy with what they had and think bowling should be a cash cow.  Bowling is dying.  People within the professional bowling community shouldn’t be trying to shrink the game with paywalls that pop up over night.  

It’s sad because is only part of a broader issue.  Companies that make money in bowling refuse to reinvest it in the sport.  Everyone wants a yacht or a Rolex.  They want to brush shoulders with other sports. But, they definitely don’t want to see bowling get back to the level it once was.  As soon as it’s at the level where they are comfortable, then they are done.  I’m looking at you, Kyle!! Brunswick, Storm.. they are all the same.   

We are in the Beanie Baby, final stage era of bowling. A new ball every week and a gimmicky sales pitch to go with it. This app attempting to grab as much money as possible from those who just want to get better at a sport that no one cares about anymore is a nail in the coffin.

reviews.title: Terrible without Subscription
reviews.text: Not a bad app for tracing scores and keeping up with houses. However, having your app be filled with pop up adds constantly where the only selling point of the subscription version being “you won’t see these adds anymore” guarantees I will never ever buy the subscription. That’s like punching someone and then telling them you’ll stop punching them for $8. Wish there was any other reason to upgrade other than inconvenience.

reviews.title: Great app but now you have to pay for everything
reviews.text: When the app first released, it was great. I was able to track every game every time then when my bowling center decided to get new equipment the app would blunt find my center to log anything automatically. I quit using it for a while because I didn’t feel like logging my games frame by frame manually. But they finally got it working with my center again and I was excited except it came with a few changes. Now you had to get a pro membership to be able to add your balls into your arsenal and see more than the last two weeks of games. I was ok with that as I only wanted to see a recap of the current week and the previous week to compare and didn’t care about what ball I used because I only ever really need to use only one ball. But now I can’t even find my current weeks game recap without signing up for a pro membership. There isn’t anything you can do without having to pay for a subscription in the app. This is a money grab and will only drive users away. I won’t be using this app anymore until it goes back to the free members being able to at least see the current weeks recap and maybe the previous week. I really liked the app but now it is useless without paying a fee.

reviews.title: Why change
reviews.text: This app has already had a some issues and kinks that have had to be worked out. But then they went to storing your games and not letting you see more than a few weeks without paying. Now you have to pay just to track your game at all. They went from being free for most things to forcing you to pay. It’s not terribly expensive but it’s more the principle of starting off with one thing and then slowly taking away features one by one until you can’t use it without paying

reviews.title: Worthless after paywall
reviews.text: I’ve never seen an app destroy itself more than this one purely because of greed. Whoever is reading this, please download this app and just click anywhere. I guarantee you have a 70% chance of the app telling you that whatever you clicked is only in the paid version. I downloaded this app because my bowling alley has the tech to send my games to the app and I can track my average. I’ve literally had the app for 2 weeks and I could simply add the games already tracked to my account. Now this is for paid members only. I haven’t even gotten into how disgusting the UI is on this app as I was able to look past it for the tracking I was wanting. I’m definitely deleting this app now and I’d rather just write my scores down manually than using this garbage app.

reviews.title: No longer free!
reviews.text: This was a very nice app, until the developers got greedy and decided to make everyone pay to use it. You used to be able to download your games to track your progress, see what spares you make and don’t make, and see your average, all for free. No longer! Now you have to pay to see those things! Granted, the price isn’t a lot, but to some of us, especially those of us on fixed incomes, paying for an app is not in the budget! So I guess I’ll just delete the app and keep track of my games myself!

reviews.title: Glitchy & Free Version is Useless
reviews.text: I had been using the free version just to track my league scores.  I’m not a big bowler, just one league per week but liked being able to see what my scores were from previous weeks, along with being able to see frame by frame, how many spares missed, etc.  Then I had to update the app and now none of those options are available in the free version.  What the heck?  Also, I often look at live scoring at a couple of different centers.  But when doing that, I will get bowlers from one center on lane 1, for example, along with bowlers on lane 1 from the other center, all on the same screen!  Very disappointed in these updates.

reviews.title: Was Great Before Paywall
reviews.text: Was a great app, you used to be able to add games with just a basic free plan. Now to add any game to your account whether it be manual entry or live scorekeeping you have to have a pro plan. This app is basically useless now unless you want to pay a subscription. Again I used to love this app but now you can’t seem to do anything without a payment plan of some kind. The newest update notes say it “refined the free experience” when it should say it just completely got rid of the “free experience”

reviews.title: Useless app due to removal of live tracking
reviews.text: What’s the point if you can’t use ANY live tracking without a subscription? This is totally useless now, I have deleted my account and uninstalled the app. Will also tell everyone I bowl with to do the same and leave 1 star reviews. You’ve brought this on yourself, this was such a great app in the past. Of course you had to destroy it with corporate greed. I would rate it 0 stars if I could and I hope you go bankrupt.

reviews.title: New Update made me Sad
reviews.text: If you asked me to rate the app last week I would have given it 5 stars. I loved the fact that Lanetalk’s free version allowed you to track your games. But I also have friends who use the paid version and I thought that those amenities were awesome. When I first started out it was nice to see my improvements and get high fives on my games. The update took this away and put it on the pay side which honestly means that the app lost a user with me. I am a league bowler but I’m not great. As I become more technical and a better bowler I saw more value in the paid version and thought about doing the upgrade and converting to see stats and make challenges but now I have a bad taste like the developers just wanted more monthly subscribers so they took away the one thing that people of all skill ranges enjoyed. I really hope that it changes back but I just deleted the app because I won’t need it in the future as is. I hope it doesn’t deter other users but for now you lost an app user because unless I get the paid version it does not provide me with anything I can use.

reviews.title: Unusable unless paid
reviews.text:
Immediately deleted this after using for a few months, with this latest update. It was annoying enough to have the overpriced pop-up ad to “go pro” every time you selected something in this app. Now, all of the data that was stored you can’t access unless you pay for pro. In fact, you can’t save anything anymore unless you pay. They did not have my ball available for input, and there was no manual way to do this either. I emailed support and got no response. Talk about “for professional bowlers”. 

There are other apps for free that take a little more work (manual entry) but you won’t catch me re-downloading this unless it’s actually free.

reviews.title: Not useful without paying
reviews.text: I have used this app since release and this most recent update has moved anything useful behind a paywall. This prevents anyone who runs side pots like survivor in large leagues or events and even a league secretary to verify score from utilizing the app anymore without paying. I would be okay with a one time low fee ($5) for permanent use of the scoring feature that was previously available. Otherwise I suggest someone should look into creating a competing app utilizing the methods Lanetalk uses to pull scores.

reviews.title: Free but not really
reviews.text: Like many FREE Apps...they are not really free are they.  This app is the same.    In the beginning you can get your scores and save them to your profile.  You can  save a picture of your stats of games bowled.  Then after awhile with an update, all that is lost and yup you got it...they want you to pay for the Pro version to get the same Free stats you had to begin with.  So disappointing with companies do that.  If you don't want us to have those features then don't give it in the beginning.
